## Analysis Summary

**Test image features:**
- Young soybean plants in greenhouse pots
- **White powdery patches scattered on upper leaf surfaces**
- Leaves otherwise green, no necrosis, no angular spots, no yellowing
- Patches appear fluffy/dusty, not water-soaked

**Comparison to candidates:**
- **Powdery_Mildew** ✅ — White to gray powdery coating on leaves; reference collage shows exact same appearance with white dusty patches covering leaf surfaces
- Downy_mildew ❌ — Shows yellow spots on upper surface, gray tufts on underside; different pattern
- White_Mold ❌ — Affects stems with fluffy growth and black sclerotia, not leaf surfaces
- All other candidates ❌ — Show brown/dark spots, necrosis, yellowing, or structural damage inconsistent with the test image

The white powdery patches on the upper leaf surfaces of young greenhouse plants is a textbook presentation of **Powdery Mildew**.
